name: grapple
brief: One-handed grapple launcher, crew suit gear: chunky safety-yellow housing over the SMG's raked pistol grip, a ratcheted reel drum cradled on top that the game spins while reeling, the feed hose to the suit out the back, a gas bottle under the nose, and a barbed harpoon sitting in the launch tube. A tool, not a weapon. Lime ready lamp, warm-white tension strips.
